shots.stamp_cn: 旧石器时代 · 星空下

captions.cn: 四万年前，有人第一次抬头，看了很久。
captions.en: Someone looked up, and looked for a long time.

captions.cn: 头顶的星空，是第一块屏幕。
captions.en: The first screen was the sky.

plate.prompt: Long-exposure night photograph: a vast brilliant Milky Way arcing from the lower right up to the upper left, its galactic core glowing with visible dust lanes and colour, hundreds of sharp stars across the whole sky. On a dark rocky ridge in the lower third, a single seated human figure seen from behind in silhouette, large enough to read clearly as a person, head tilted upward. A small campfire beside them throws warm amber rim light along the shoulder and cheek and lights a pool of ground. Photoreal, shot on 35mm film, deep blue-black sky, high dynamic range, correctly exposed for the stars.
plate.video_note: v3(09-29 ¥5)：星野清晰无涂抹、银河缓旋、火堆从余烬烧成明火、人物剪影逐帧零位移（红绿双帧叠影实测）→ 整幅直接用视频，不再叠任何静止遮罩层

plate.prompt: Ancient Shang dynasty divination scene, dark bronze tones: a dried, flat turtle plastron and a polished ox scapula lying on packed earth, no living creature anywhere in the frame, only the dry carved shell. Flames lick the lower edge of the plastron from the very bottom of the frame, warm amber light rising upward. The shell surface is smooth and unbroken, with no fissures on it. Bronze-green accents inside a warm amber palette, shallow depth of field, heavy film grain, strong vignette.

plate.prompt: Night in the desert after moonset, photoreal film still: a vast dune field whose sand is warmly lit by a small campfire burning at the lower right edge of frame, long shadows and crisp wind ripples with individual grains catching the light. A tiny distant crouching human silhouette in the lower-right third, under 12 percent of frame height, drawing lines in the sand with one hand. The upper third of the frame is deep blue-black night sky with only a few first stars and no Milky Way. The mid-lower sand is generously exposed and clearly readable; darkness lives only in the sky and at the frame edges.
plate.negative: ★人影必须小且远：剪影高度 <12% 画面、位于右下 1/3；上 1/3 留给夜空；中下与底部留给代码层与字幕
plate.prompt_v2_rejected: v1 底图 mean 27.3 但沙面在暗部、人影占画面 13%×28%（比 S01 还大）；用户 2026-09-28：很暗、看不到沙子、很简陋。v2 改月落后暖沙 + 远景小剪影。
plate.negative_note: no underexposed muddy sand, no black dunes, no bright Milky Way, no large or near human figure, no face, no readable characters, no text, no watermark, no modern objects.
plate.cand_note: r4 沙面仍泥(11.8)；r5 过曝 3.04% 顶破闸门；r6 左上带一缕银河（S01 专属母题不该复现）；r9 火光呈放射状阴影辐条太假；r8 沙偏暗。取 r7：人影最小(~10% 画面高)、沙纹全幅可读、火在画内、夜空只有初星、过曝 2.69% 有余量。

plate.prompt: Five shallow wooden trays in a row on a dark table under one low overhead lamp. The four trays at the left are filled level with fine pale sand: individual grains, a few raked ridges and small hollows clearly readable on each surface, matte and powdery. The fifth tray at the right is completely empty, showing bare scratched dry wood. All surfaces are diffuse and non-luminous, lit only by the lamp, never self-emitting. Deep neutral shadow closes in around the row. Photoreal still-life, macro lens, shallow focus.

plate.prompt: Extreme close-up of an antique brass telegraph key standing on a bare dark wooden desk. A heavy brass lever with a black ebonite knob, a spring, a binding post and one coiled copper wire, tarnish and fingerprints on the metal. Nothing else on the desk surface. A single low warm lamp outside the frame at the left rakes across the brass and falls off quickly into deep shadow; a rain-blurred window and telegraph poles far behind, out of focus. Photoreal, 35mm film still, macro depth of field.

shots.stamp_cn: 曼彻斯特 · 达特茅斯

captions.cn: 一九五〇年，一篇论文的第一句，是一个问题：
captions.en: In 1950, a paper opened with a question:

captions.cn: 机器能思考吗？六年后，它有了名字：人工智能。
captions.en: Can machines think? Six years later, it had a name: Artificial Intelligence.

plate.prompt: Dark moody photoreal still life: a black 1950s typewriter centred slightly below the middle of the frame, a cone of hard light from an industrial desk lamp at the upper right, dust and smoke particles floating in the beam. A clean empty sheet of plain white paper is rolled in, carrying no printing and no marks of any kind. Deep amber and near-black palette, heavy film grain, strong vignette, cinematic low-key lighting, no people.
plate.negative: ★纸面必须空白：Can machines think? 由代码叠加（原片该场文字不跟纸面透视走，我们沿用同一做法）

anchors.note: 打字机字体行 1 —— TBD 需对齐纸面倾角

shots.qc_note: "六年"口径：Dartmouth 提案文本首用 Artificial Intelligence 是 1955（McCarthy 本人页），会议在 1956 → 按提案为五年、按命名为六年。字幕取"六年"，QC 表要注这一行。

captions.cn: 三千年来，第一次，人工智能接了这个问题。
captions.en: For the first time in three thousand years, AI caught the question.

captions.cn: 有人开始对它说，只肯对它说的话。
captions.en: Some began telling it what they told no one else.

plate.prompt: 1966 computer laboratory, photoreal film still: a small oscilloscope-terminal monitor sitting LOW in the frame, its glass curved and its screen a deep muted green glow with clearly visible horizontal scanlines and soft uneven phosphor falloff, lighting only the desk immediately in front of it. Most of the frame is a dark room: cables, a rack of equipment in shadow, and the back of a seated person in silhouette at the left. Cold green and deep blue-black palette, no warm light, shallow depth of field, heavy 35mm film grain.
plate.negative: ★屏幕必须小而暗、有扫描线纹理，不许是一整块高饱和纯色矩形

plate.negative_note: no warm orange light, no bright flat single-colour screen, no readable characters, no letters, no text, no faces, no watermark.
plate.cand_note: r5 屏幕有波形但左上背景坐了第二个人、构图抢戏；r6 屏幕仍在右缘且偏亮(mean 14.9)。取 r4：绿屏只占 1.33%（旧图是一整块高饱和矩形）、居中 x46.5-54.8%/y45-64.9%、左上 x4-34%/y16-46% 实测均值 5.3 = 全图最暗，正好放对话。桌面那摊暖光保留——它是本片调色纪律里的琥珀中间调，旧图的问题从来不是"有暖色"，而是绿块太大太纯。

plate.prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-wash on aged warm rice paper, vertical composition: a single strong black ink-brush trunk enters from the TOP edge of the frame and descends straight down the centre, passing through a faint horizontal ink ground line at about 45% height; below that line its roots spread downward and outward in a fan of dry-brush ink strokes, occupying the lower 55%. Above the ground line the trunk continues with small coral-red plum blossoms at a few side branch tips. Vast empty warm off-white paper. No labels, no writing anywhere, and no red seal stamp and no chop mark on the paper. Subtle paper fibre texture, restrained Song dynasty aesthetic, black ink with vermilion accents only. No text, no watermark.

plate.prompt: Night interior, photoreal: a rain-streaked window with blurred city lights outside, a wooden desk, an open laptop as the only light source. Its screen glows warm amber, filled with faint out-of-focus horizontal bands of light like text far too blurred to read, and a soft bloom spills onto the desk and the papers beside it. Deep teal shadows, shallow depth of field, heavy 35mm film grain, cinematic low-key but generously exposed so the screen has visible gradient and structure.

plate.cand_note: v2 三抽(r4-r6)全部不采纳：r6 画出了人（禁令违反）；r5 屏幕跑到 x68-90% 且多一盏台灯=第二个光源；r4 屏幕纹理最好但右侧有红色霓虹招牌，违反全片暖色纪律。 决定：留 r1 那块纯色琥珀屏 —— 它本来就是给代码层留的底，"无内容无扫描线"的正解是在代码层画扫描线/明暗/光标余辉（三层混合架构的本职），不是让模型去画假 UI。锚点也不必重标。

plate_b.prompt: Cave interior at night, photoreal: a dark rock overhang across the very top, and above the cave mouth a brilliant star-filled night sky with a luminous Milky Way. Below it a slanting sandstone wall covered with layered prehistoric rock art — dozens of red-ochre handprints of many sizes and ages, overlapping, some faded, plus painted deer and bison silhouettes in dark ochre red. A small campfire burns low at the right, raking warm amber light across the painted wall so the handprints glow. Generously exposed, the whole wall clearly legible, darkness only at the frame edges. Heavy 35mm film grain.
